title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: 1) Get the fuck out of the comments
2) It was fine. But I think that by throwing Verlander and yourself under the bus, no one is going to be a winner here.
My point being that you all set out to be transparent and you succeeded in it. It may not work out like you thought, but you were fair
Yeah. It was (too) late, like you said. Probably too in-depth. But faved with get my side out or not get it out, went with offense.
I dunno. I like your honest opinion, though
Yeah, ultimately, this whole thing was fucked from the get go. But the more I read it, the more I’m glad you at least stuck up for yourself.
Appreciate you being accessible during all this shit
And I also feel like you give real honest opinions
Glad I could be of some help. Any good feedback on it today?
